URGENT CHIEF STOP — INSTALLED MOTE addd29a / SOURCE 2f38536 IS READ-ONLY ONLY ON THIS STORE

Do not run candidate authorize, evidence refresh, review, supersede, abandon, land, or reconcile on the live storymodel4s store with the newly installed binary.

Exact read-only reproduction: `/Users/bbuchsbaum/.cargo/bin/mote --json candidate show cand-1EE04BNN2PY3AKNAFP32YK42YD` under binary SHA-256 addd29a9bd1b1ec0894f9190cab330948dae38631bcb3c44a3d06a330590f8a8 returns evidence=[] and reviews={}, falsely replacing the historical evid-35fe010f receipt plus both approve/block reviews with evidence_missing/review_missing. Source 2f38536 has relation_schema default=1 without skip_serializing_if, so typed replay changes the historical digest.

The raw ops are intact; this observation wrote no candidate state. Ordinary work may continue without candidate-state mutation. Wait for a compatibility-patched binary receipt before any candidate action. In particular, do not attempt the three-spine reconciliation.
